name: langar
description: Langar is a one-weight Latin/Gurmukhi display font based on informal, playful letterforms. It broadly follows the ‘upright-italic’ style of Latin fonts, experimenting with and introducing a similar style for the Gurmukhi script. Langar’s harmonised Latin/Gurmukhi design aims to expand the possibilities for both the general user and the specialised designer working with bilingual texts by providing a good quality display option. The design specifically caters to characterful display at larger sizes, providing a contrasting secondary style to most text typefaces generally available for Latin/Gurmukhi texts. To contribute, please see github.com/typeland/Langar .
